_comment: Ground truth for resume tailoring. The tailoring LLM call selects, reorders, and lightly rewords content FROM this file only -- it is explicitly instructed never to invent employers, dates, titles, or quantitative claims not present here. employer_bullets are fixed (never dropped or fabricated, may be reordered within an employer); projects/tagline/profile are the flexible pool it selects and adapts from per job description.
tagline_options: Software Engineer  •  AI-Driven Automation & Team Enablement  •  API & Cloud Systems
AI Engineer  •  Agentic Systems & Tool-Using Pipelines  •  Production LLM Applications
Full-Stack & AI Engineer  •  System Architecture & Implementation  •  0-to-1 Product Delivery
profile_summary_options: Software Engineer with 6+ years building and implementing solutions that measurably reduce team workload and increase effectiveness — from AI-directed deployment automation to internal tooling that cuts debugging time roughly 10x. Proven at owning implementations end-to-end: production APIs, CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, and agentic AI workflows that free engineers and teams to focus on higher-value work. Comfortable moving from architecture to hands-on delivery, and from writing code to shipping tools other people rely on daily.

AI Engineer with 6+ years shipping production systems and hands-on experience building agentic, tool-using AI systems — pipelines that extract, reason, call tools, verify their own output, and hand off to a human when uncertain, rather than guessing. Fluent in Python day to day with a verification-first mindset: every system I build gets evaluated and instrumented, not trusted on faith. I ship working systems, not prototypes.

Full-stack engineer with 6+ years of experience who has both maintained large existing platforms and built products from zero — data model, backend, frontend, and the product judgment to fill in incomplete requirements. Comfortable owning a domain end-to-end rather than working from a fully-specified ticket queue.

bullets.text: Headed implementation of software deployments to production servers and AWS infrastructure for the CIO Risk Team, directing AI-driven automation of the deployment process to eliminate manual release steps.

Used agentic AI development to move through tickets significantly faster, raising personal and team-wide velocity while owning release management end-to-end, coordinating cross-functional communication and live issue resolution with business stakeholders.
Compressed new engineer onboarding from 6 months to 1 month through structured training programs and documentation — raising the floor for every new hire on the team.
Work directly with clients day to day as the primary technical integration contact implementing Highway's API systems — reducing onboarding friction and accelerating time-to-production.
Built internal debugging tooling that cuts issue-diagnosis time roughly 10x for the team, and automated agentic workflows that offload repetitive client-facing processes.
Diagnose, reproduce, and document complex API bugs — translating findings into detailed specs that directly drive feature enhancements.
Built dashboards for the team that automate data gathering and report generation, removing manual reporting work entirely.
Ship full internal MVP applications — from idea to a tool in daily use in as little as a couple of days.

projects.name: AI Claims Denial Triage & Appeal System
projects.description: Agentic document pipeline: forced structured tool-use extraction, confidence-gated classification, and grounded generation — backed by a deterministic eval/regression harness (95% accuracy) and an immutable audit trail of every AI and human decision. Config-driven multi-tenant design serves two distinct document schemas from one codebase; live cost tracking at $0.05/unit.

projects.name: og-voice — Tool-Executing AI Voice Agent
projects.description: Push-to-talk desktop agent that takes voice or typed commands and executes real system actions, gated behind an explicit, audit-logged permission control, with a persistent skills/context system and full per-session cost tracking.

projects.name: AI Generation Job Queue
projects.description: Persistent, server-side job queue for long-running AI image/video generation workloads — survives client disconnect, cancellable mid-run, with automatic restart-recovery. Real infrastructure engineering for asynchronous AI workloads.

projects.name: OG-DB — Automated, LLM-Assisted Data Pipeline
projects.description: Public reference database (10 datasets, 580+ rows) with a weekly automated pipeline that scrapes live pricing data and uses a local LLM to resolve ambiguous product matches before publishing price-history trends.
